title: crinum pumilum
intro: Crinum pumilum, commonly known as the Dwarf Crinum, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Crinum pumilum include its ability to exhibit antispasmodic, antihypertensive, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
